results.description: Gist client fetches metadata from configured Gist ID

payload.evidence: vitest: 'TC-001-01: Gist client fetches metadata from configured Gist ID' in lib/__tests__/gistClient.test.ts passes. fetchPosts(['configured-gist-id']) returns 1 post with correct slug, title, date, and gistId.
payload.notes: Test mocks GitHub API, verifies fetchPosts extracts metadata (slug, title, date, gistId) from the Gist response.

results.description: Config resolves Gist ID from env/config

payload.evidence: vitest: 'TC-001-02: Config resolves Gist ID from env/config' in config/__tests__/gist.test.ts passes. Setting GIST_IDS='id1,id2,id3' yields ['id1','id2','id3']. Additional tests confirm whitespace trimming and empty/unset env returns [].
payload.notes: Config module correctly parses comma-separated GIST_IDS env var.

results.description: Post list component displays title and preview/date for each post

payload.evidence: vitest: PostCard tests in components/__tests__/PostCard.test.tsx pass. 'renders post title' confirms h2 with title text; 'renders formatted date' confirms date display (Feb 20, 2025); 'renders preview when present' confirms preview text.
payload.notes: PostCard component renders title (h2), formatted date, and preview for each post.

results.description: Post list is ordered by date (newest first)

payload.evidence: vitest: 'fetchPosts sorts posts from multiple gists by date descending' in lib/__tests__/gistClient.test.ts passes. Two gists with dates 2025-01-10 and 2025-02-15 are returned with the newer post first.
payload.notes: fetchPosts sorts by date descending using Date.getTime() comparison.

payload.evidence: vitest: 'links to /posts/[slug]' in components/__tests__/PostCard.test.tsx passes. Link href equals '/posts/my-first-post'. Additionally, gistClient test confirms slug generation from filename ('my-awesome-post.md' → 'my-awesome-post').
payload.notes: PostCard renders an anchor with href='/posts/{slug}'.

payload.evidence: Lint: 'next lint' exits 0 with one non-blocking warning (@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars in app/__tests__/page.test.tsx). Typecheck: 'tsc --noEmit' exits 2 with errors: schemas/validate-progress.ts(1,32) TS2307 Cannot find module './tmpl_progress'; schemas/validate-state.ts(1,29) TS2307 Cannot find module './tmpl_state'.
payload.notes: Typecheck fails due to missing module references in schemas/ directory (agent tooling files, not project source code). Project source files themselves have no type errors. Lint passes (warning only, no errors).

results.description: Gist client fetches file content by slug

payload.evidence: vitest: 'fetchPostContent returns file content when gist and file exist' in lib/__tests__/gistClient.test.ts passes. Returns '# My Post\n\nFull content here.' for matching gistId/filename. Also 'getPostBySlug returns post with content when slug matches' passes, confirming end-to-end slug→content retrieval.
payload.notes: fetchPostContent and getPostBySlug both correctly fetch full file content from Gist API.

results.description: Markdown renderer converts content to HTML

payload.evidence: vitest: All 7 tests in components/__tests__/PostContent.test.tsx pass. Headings render as h1/h2/h3, unordered/ordered lists render, code blocks and inline code render as <code> elements, links render with href, paragraphs render.
payload.notes: PostContent uses react-markdown to convert markdown to HTML. All tested markdown constructs render correctly.

results.description: Post detail page displays post title

payload.evidence: vitest: 'displays the post title when post is found' in app/posts/[slug]/__tests__/page.test.tsx passes. h1 heading contains 'My Awesome Post'. Source confirms post.title rendered in <h1 className='post-title'>.
payload.notes: PostPage renders the post title from getPostBySlug result as an h1 element.

results.description: Post has title and body derived from Gist

payload.evidence: vitest: 'renders post content via PostContent when post is found' in app/posts/[slug]/__tests__/page.test.tsx passes. Content '**Bold** and _italic_ text.' renders with 'Bold' and 'italic' text visible. Title comes from getPostBySlug (Gist-derived), body from PostContent rendering Gist markdown.
payload.notes: Post title and body are both derived from Gist data via getPostBySlug and rendered by PostPage.

results.description: Back link or navigation returns to list

payload.evidence: vitest: 'renders a back link to the home page' and 'renders back link even when post is not found' both pass in app/posts/[slug]/__tests__/page.test.tsx. Back link has href='/' and text '← Back to list'.
payload.notes: Back link is rendered in both found and not-found states, always pointing to '/'.

payload.evidence: Lint: 'next lint' exits 0 with one non-blocking warning. Typecheck: 'tsc --noEmit' exits 2 with errors in schemas/validate-progress.ts and schemas/validate-state.ts (TS2307: Cannot find module).
payload.notes: Same typecheck failure as TC-001-06. Errors are in schemas/ tooling files, not project source. Project source files have no type errors. Lint passes.

results.description: Gist fetch failure shows explicit error state

payload.evidence: vitest: 'fetchGist returns null when API fails' in gistClient.test.ts passes (API returns ok:false → null). 'fetchPostContent returns null when gist fetch fails' passes. In PostPage, when getPostBySlug returns null, the UI renders 'Post not found' heading and 'No post was found for "{slug}"' message. Test 'renders back link even when post is not found' confirms this path.
payload.notes: Error chain: fetch failure → fetchGist returns null → getPostBySlug returns null → PostPage renders explicit 'Post not found' error state with back link.

results.description: Invalid or missing Gist ID yields graceful fallback

payload.evidence: vitest: 'returns empty array when GIST_IDS is unset' and 'returns empty array when GIST_IDS is empty string' pass in config/__tests__/gist.test.ts. 'shows graceful fallback when GIST_IDS is empty' in app/__tests__/page.test.tsx passes, confirming 'No posts yet' and 'Configure GIST_IDS' messages are displayed.
payload.notes: Missing/invalid GIST_IDS yields empty array, and HomePage shows graceful empty-state fallback.

results.description: Markdown with code blocks renders code element

payload.evidence: vitest: 'renders code blocks' passes — markdown '```js\nconst x = 1;\n```' renders 'const x = 1;' inside a <code> element (tagName === 'code'). 'renders inline code' also passes — '`console.log()`' renders as <code> element.
payload.notes: Both fenced code blocks and inline code render as <code> HTML elements.

results.description: Markdown with links renders anchor elements

payload.evidence: vitest: 'renders links with href' passes — markdown '[Click here](https://example.com)' renders an anchor element with role 'link', name 'Click here', and href 'https://example.com'.
payload.notes: Markdown links correctly render as <a> elements with proper href attributes.
